source_document: Summer Schedule.pdf (PlayLive Melbourne, Canva, two pages)
venue: PlayLive Melbourne, 129 York St, South Melbourne VIC 3205
notes: Featured rows are the two headline events: the $1,500 Main Event ($500K GTD, four flights, Day 2, final 36 and final table) and the $2,500 Melbourne Millions Main Event ($1M GTD). Day 2+ rows are qualifiers only.

Buy-in shown as total, then entry + fee; the Terminator is entry + bounty + fee. A satellite's guarantee is the number of seats it pays (seats_guaranteed); the BIG5@PlayLive satellite pays packages (packages_guaranteed).

rego_ends_time is the late-registration clock time the poster prints, "Day 2" where registration runs to the start of Day 2, or empty for a final day. The poster prints no late-rego level, shot clock, re-entry column or room.
live_stream marks the rows the poster tags LIVE (Day 2s and final tables).
The poster's "Triple Duece" is recorded as Triple Deuce. Where the poster limits entries it says so in the event name (single re-entry, no re-entry), kept as printed.
